title: AI Development Manager Autonomous Continuation Chain
description: Foundation-only state/data contract for the hands-off dispatch -> evidence -> validate -> next-task loop. Records here are decision-engine bookkeeping; they never represent a provider launch by themselves.

chain_id.description: Stable identity for one autonomous continuation lineage; carried across every task/execution the chain dispatches.

root_request_id.description: Originating dispatch request id for the chain as a whole. Immutable for the life of the chain. Slice 0 (the chain's original dispatch) may equal this value -- it IS that dispatch. Every automatic continuation slice (slice_index >= 1) must use its own distinct request_id and may never reuse this value or any earlier slice's request_id.

task_id.description: Convenience mirror of the current slice's task_id; full per-slice history lives in `slices`.

execution_id.description: Convenience mirror of the current slice's most recent execution_id; full retry history lives in `slices[].execution_ids`.

session_id.description: Convenience mirror of the current slice's session_id.

handoff_id.description: Convenience mirror of the current slice's handoff_id.

depth.description: Number of automatic continuations already taken in this chain; equals the current slice's slice_index.

max_depth.description: Configurable ceiling on automatic continuation depth.

retry_count.description: Bounded retry counter for the CURRENT slice only. Reset to 0 whenever a new slice starts; mirrors slices[-1].retry_count.

max_retries.description: Configurable ceiling on bounded automatic retries per slice.

is_production_mutating.description: Whether the current/candidate slice writes to production; drives the single-writer mutual-exclusion gate.

action_kind.description: Classifies the current/candidate slice for the irreversible-action stop gate.

slices.description: Append-only per-slice lineage. Never mutated once a later slice exists; a retry updates the current (last) slice in place, a new automatic continuation appends a new entry.

request_id.description: This slice's own dispatch request_id/idempotency key. Slice 0 may equal root_request_id (it IS the chain's original dispatch); every slice with slice_index >= 1 is an automatic continuation and must be distinct from root_request_id and from every other slice's request_id.

execution_ids.description: Every execution attempt for this slice, in order, including retries.

outcome.description: This slice's most recent validation outcome; overwritten in place if a retry re-validates the same slice.
